data.content_ref: inline:The necessity of separate engines based on shared training priors (SRC_003) contradicts the possibility of simulating independence via context wipes (SRC_002), as a complete context wipe removes the trace of the authoring process but does not remove the underlying 'Cognitive Covariance' of the weights; this is refuted if a stateless checker consistently arrives at the same error as the author despite the absence of a process trace.
